neighbours.label: A split-off word-opening 'b' piece, as ' b' in French words (' b|ateaux') or '-b' after a hyphen ('grey-b|rown'); other words in the same slot stay quiet.
fire: On voyait sur le quai des bretteurs et des caisses.
Le village abrite un grand nombre de biches.
Il y avait des biches dans le bois.
The wall was painted a grey-brown shade.
The horse had a reddish-brown coat.
The leaves turn a yellowish-brown color in fall.
The bird has dark grey-brown wings.
Les marins aiment les bateaux de ce port.

Il y avait des cerfs dans le bois.
The wall was painted a dark shade.
